material_findings.earliest_owner: S1/DELL-RSQ-03B absolute evidence-unit position and typed material-anchor coverage
material_findings.finding: R4 globally deduplicates normalized source sentences before assigning unit positions, so 20 identical intervening units collapse and a genuinely 22-unit-separated ASP pair becomes span 3 and complete. Material numeric/time coverage also uses raw substring containment: source anchor 15 is treated as covered by compiled 150, and bare product-code digits can enter the anchor fingerprint.
material_findings.impact: False adjacency or false coverage can create a complete local package, suppress an external route, or remove/create a local-repair and reranker eligibility decision.
material_findings.required_successor: R5 must assign immutable raw positions before any display/family deduplication and preserve occurrence positions, while material numeric and time anchors use typed token-exact normalized equality with product-code and unit boundaries.

material_findings.earliest_owner: S1/DELL-RSQ-03B polarity, direction, process, shipper and allocation role guards
material_findings.finding: R4 still classifies controlled negatives as complete for supplier, yield, Dell units, capacity and HBM. The guards miss ordinary no/lack/denied/never/not/unavailable polarity; planned/forecast/will future phrases; N2 pilot-line wrong-process values; and reported-speech seller/shipper direction such as Dell said NVIDIA shipped.
material_findings.impact: Future runs can convert negative, prospective, wrong-process or counterparty activity into affirmative local evidence and distort local-versus-external routing even though the immutable R4 corpus observations themselves remain deterministic.
material_findings.required_successor: R5 must add scoped token-bound polarity, directional subject-object and reported-speech seller/shipper guards, symmetric future/planned/forecast qualifiers, wrong-process and pilot-line exclusions, and freeze every reproduced attack as a regression.

material_findings.earliest_owner: S3 Writer and reader-visible citation compiler
material_findings.finding: R17 exposes internal EV/GAP identifiers but no reader-visible claim-level URL, source title, issuer or publisher, paired measurement/publication period, page or section locator, source role, bibliography or source appendix.
material_findings.verified_positive_boundary: All 39 R17 surfaces, 42 claim references, 18 unique Evidence references and 10 unique gap references resolve through the R10 authority catalog and source bindings.
material_findings.impact: A reader cannot independently verify claims, so formal report quality remains invalid.
material_findings.required_successor: A non-overwriting report successor must implement the frozen claim-level citation and source-appendix contract after evidence and numeric truth are ready.

material_findings.earliest_owner: S3 report compiler and source-closure program
material_findings.finding: Current Pack remains 55 Evidence and 14 gaps with zero closures. R17 predates and does not consume the 14 Pack / 9 R38 / 4 Writer-group / 10 Writer-gap-reference crosswalk. Four Pack gaps are not referenced by Writer: price-in boundary, scenario or sensitivity, supplier-capacity read-through and valuation basis.
material_findings.required_successor: Consume the frozen crosswalk without relabelling route aggregation as closure.

material_findings.finding: All six R17 WWC items lack a structured owner, frozen observation window, calibrated threshold and authority, and complete evidence route. Qualifiers such as visibly elevated, persistent decline, material and minimal are not operational thresholds.
material_findings.required_successor: Operationalize every material WWC before report acceptance.

material_findings.finding: R17 has 20574 characters and 71 fact occurrences but only 38 unique fact fragments; inventory 15.052B appears five times, revenue 43.842B appears three times, and all six WWC themes are duplicated across body and top-level presentation.
material_findings.required_successor: Deduplicate presentation after evidence and numeric truth are frozen.

next_legal_action: Preserve R4 unchanged and open one non-overwriting same-stage R5 with a fresh policy, authority and attempt. Retain raw absolute positions before deduplication, require typed token-exact numeric and time anchors, strengthen scoped polarity, direction, seller or shipper, future, planned, forecast, pilot-line and wrong-process guards, and freeze all reproduced attacks as regressions. Obtain another fresh author-separated dual audit before any 03C, 4B, reranker, Evidence or downstream execution.
